newsitem.title: USA: Bristol-Myers acquires rights to antibiotic.
newsitem.headline: Bristol-Myers acquires rights to antibiotic.

text.p: Bristol-Myers Squibb Co said on Tuesday it acquired the rights to a broad-spectrum antibiotic from Japan's Kyorin Pharmaceutical Co Ltd.
Bristol-Myers said it acquired development and marketing rights in the U.S., Canada, Brazil, and other worldwide markets for gatifloxacin, a broad-spectrum fluoroquinolone.
The antibiotic is for treating bacterial infections, including urinary tract and respiratory infections.
Under the deal, Bristol-Myers will provide up-front and milestone payments to Kyorin as well as royalty payments after marketing. It did not detail the financial terms.
Gatifloxacin is in Phase III clinical trials in Japan and in Phase I/II clinical studies in Europe.
